question: In fiscal 2024, what percentage of Cloudflare's (NYSE: NET) revenue was derived from channel partners?
answer: 20% of revenue was derived from channel partners

rubric.criteria: 20% of revenue was derived from channel partners
Cloudflare fiscal 2024 channel partner revenue percentage
20% revenue from channel partners in fiscal 2024
20% of revenue was derived from channel partners

model_answer:
**20% of Cloudflare's fiscal 2024 revenue came from channel partners.**

Per Cloudflare's Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024 (filed February 20, 2025), revenue disaggregated by type of customer was:

| Customer type | FY2024 revenue | % of revenue | FY2023 | YoY |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Channel partners | $337.4M | **20%** | $202.4M (16%) | +67% |
| Direct customers | $1,332.2M | 80% | $1,094.3M (84%) | +22% |
| **Total** | **$1,669.6M** | **100%** | $1,296.7M | +29% |

Channel partner share has risen steadily — from 13% in FY2022 to 16% in FY2023 to 20% in FY2024 — with channel revenue growing faster than direct (channel was 22% of revenue in Q4 2024 alone).
judge_reason: The answer correctly states 20% of Cloudflare's fiscal 2024 revenue was derived from channel partners.
